name: tlib
description: Shared UI and utility library for FiveM resources

scripts.setup: bun install && cd client/web && bun install
scripts.//test:lua:control: Negative control for tests/lua/framerelay-election.lua, the two-client relay suite, and for tests/lua/runtimetxd-create-once.lua. Two planted defects, each of which must turn an EXACT named set of assertions red: `election` makes both clients report themselves the controller (planted in the real code path -- publishTick computes `mine` from tlib.occupancy.isController, so the module genuinely admits two writers on one statebag key, which is the pre-election bug replayed), and `clock` stops the world clock, the module's only notion of time and the one way a relay reasoned entirely about elapsed milliseconds can look perfect while measuring nothing. The runtimetxd half plants its two defects (`nocache`, `notag`) in the MODULE'S OWN SOURCE -- patched into the OS temp dir, since fengari ships no `io` -- and asserts each substitution matched exactly once, because a gsub that matched nothing hands the suite the unmodified module and the control then asserts that correct code is correct. Both runners also check each mode exits NON-ZERO with the control's own summary line rather than an unrelated crash, and that the suite is GREEN at baseline.
scripts.test:lua:control: bun run scripts/framerelay-control.ts && bun run scripts/runtimetxd-control.ts
scripts.//probe:focus: Proves the shared focus indicator PAINTS PIXELS, in the pinned Chromium 103, inside an overflow-hidden ancestor -- the geometry in which a ring's outward box-shadow is clipped to nothing. Reads each consumer's REAL built stylesheet and asserts every class string appears verbatim in the component source beside it, so it cannot drift into agreeing with itself. NOT in `verify`: it needs tELS, tAFK, tCAD and tRadio/server built first, and `verify` does not build them. Two controls per case, each REQUIRED to paint 0 -- the box-shadow a ring compiles to, and the same outline at a positive offset.
scripts.check:regression: bun run typecheck && bun run typecheck:shared && bun run check:imports && bun run test && bun run test:lua && bun run test:lua:control
scripts.verify: bun run lint && bun run check:regression && bun run build
